name: globe
title: 点阵地球
description: 用点阵绘制的 WebGL 地球，颜色跟随主题，支持城市标记、标签、弧线、拖拽旋转与离屏暂停。

"use client" import * as React from "react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { flowToneStyle } from "@/registry/lib/flow-tone" import { anglesFor } from "./projection" import type { GlobeArc, GlobeMarker, GlobeTone } from "./types" import { useGlobe } from "./use-globe" // 默认视角：正对东亚，略微俯视 const DEFAULT_VIEW = anglesFor([24, 104]) type GlobeProps = Omit, "children"> & { /** * 标记点；`label` 填城市名，读屏会逐个朗读，开启 `labels` 后显示为胶囊 * @default [] */ markers?: GlobeMarker[] /** * 两点之间的弧线 * @default [] */ arcs?: GlobeArc[] /** * 点阵（陆地）的色调 * @default "foreground" */ dotTone?: GlobeTone /** * 标记的默认色调 * @default "primary" */ markerTone?: GlobeTone /** * 弧线的默认色调 * @default "primary" */ arcTone?: GlobeTone /** * 自转速度，单位弧度 / 秒；负值反向 * @default 0.12 */ speed?: number /** 初始水平角（弧度），默认正对东亚；`globeAngles([纬度, 经度])` 可以算出对准某个地点的角度 */ phi?: number /** 初始俯仰角（弧度）；拖拽松手后会回到这个角度 */ theta?: number /** * 允许拖拽旋转，松手后带惯性并恢复自转；键盘左右方向键也可旋转 * @default false */ draggable?: boolean /** * 暂停自转；拖拽和聚焦不受影响 * @default false */ paused?: boolean /** * 陆地点阵的采样数，越大越密，也越吃显卡 * @default 16000 */ mapSamples?: number /** * 在标记旁显示城市名胶囊（背面时自动隐藏）；单个标记的 `showLabel` 优先 * @default false */ labels?: boolean /** 让地球缓动转向并停在 `[纬度, 经度]`，传 `null` 恢复自转 */ focus?: [number, number] | null /** 图示说明；不传时作为装饰隐藏（可拖拽时回落到默认说明） */ label?: string } /** * 调整用的覆盖项：子树里所有 `Globe` 的对应属性被这里的值替换。 * 用于调试面板一类的场景；不包 `GlobeTuningContext.Provider` 时组件行为不变。 */ type GlobeTuning = { speed?: number phi?: number theta?: number dotTone?: GlobeTone markerTone?: GlobeTone mapSamples?: number labels?: boolean draggable?: boolean paused?: boolean /** 回报示例自己的实际取值（未被覆盖前），面板据此显示当前值。 */ onReport?: (values: GlobeReport) => void } type GlobeReport = { speed: number phi: number theta: number dotTone: GlobeTone markerTone: GlobeTone mapSamples: number labels: boolean draggable: boolean paused: boolean } const GlobeTuningContext = React.createContext({}) /** * 点阵地球：WebGL 绘制陆地点阵、标记与弧线，颜色取自主题变量， * 亮暗模式和颜色主题切换时自动更新。尺寸由外框决定，外框是正方形，球体占其中约 80%。 */ function Globe({ className, markers = [], arcs = [], dotTone: dotToneProp = "foreground", markerTone: markerToneProp = "primary", arcTone = "primary", speed: speedProp = 0.12, phi: phiProp = DEFAULT_VIEW.phi, theta: thetaProp = DEFAULT_VIEW.theta, draggable: draggableProp = false, paused: pausedProp = false, mapSamples: mapSamplesProp = 16000, labels: labelsProp = false, focus, label: labelProp, ...props }: GlobeProps) { const tuning = React.useContext(GlobeTuningContext) const { onReport } = tuning React.useEffect(() => { onReport?.({ speed: speedProp, phi: phiProp, theta: thetaProp, dotTone: dotToneProp, markerTone: markerToneProp, mapSamples: mapSamplesProp, labels: labelsProp, draggable: draggableProp, paused: pausedProp, }) }, [ onReport, speedProp, phiProp, thetaProp, dotToneProp, markerToneProp, mapSamplesProp, labelsProp, draggableProp, pausedProp, ]) const speed = tuning.speed ?? speedProp const phi = tuning.phi ?? phiProp const theta = tuning.theta ?? thetaProp const dotTone = tuning.dotTone ?? dotToneProp const markerTone = tuning.markerTone ?? markerToneProp const mapSamples = tuning.mapSamples ?? mapSamplesProp const labels = tuning.labels ?? labelsProp const draggable = tuning.draggable ?? draggableProp const paused = tuning.paused ?? pausedProp const label = labelProp ?? (draggable ? "可旋转的地球" : undefined) const { rootRef, hostRef, labelRefs, ready, dragging, handlers } = useGlobe({ markers, arcs, dotTone, markerTone, arcTone, speed, phi, theta, draggable, paused, mapSamples, labels, focus, }) const cities = markers.flatMap((marker) => marker.label ? [marker.label] : [], ) const description = label ? cities.length ? `${label}，标注：${cities.join("、")}` : label : undefined return (
{/* 画布出来之前（含服务端输出）先占位，尺寸与球体一致，避免布局跳动 */}
{markers.map((marker, index) => (marker.showLabel ?? labels) && marker.label ? (
{ labelRefs.current[index] = node }} data-slot="globe-label" className="absolute top-0 left-0 opacity-0 will-change-transform" style={flowToneStyle(marker.tone ?? markerTone)} > {marker.label}
) : null, )}
) } type GlobeLegendProps = React.ComponentProps<"ul"> & { markers: GlobeMarker[] /** * 默认色调，与 `Globe` 的 `markerTone` 保持一致 * @default "primary" */ markerTone?: GlobeTone /** * 同时列出经纬度（等宽字体） * @default false */ coordinates?: boolean } /** 标记图例：名称配彩色圆点，可选经纬度；放在地球旁边，给不依赖颜色与动画的文字版本。 */ function GlobeLegend({ className, markers, markerTone = "primary", coordinates = false, ...props }: GlobeLegendProps) { return (
    {markers.map((marker, index) => marker.label ? (
  • {marker.label} {coordinates ? ( {marker.location[0].toFixed(1)}°,{" "} {marker.location[1].toFixed(1)}° ) : null}
    • ) : null, )}
) } export { Globe, GlobeLegend, GlobeTuningContext, anglesFor as globeAngles } export type { GlobeArc, GlobeLegendProps, GlobeMarker, GlobeProps, GlobeReport, GlobeTone, GlobeTuning, }
